note: San Diego County Registrar official results for the June 8, 2010 primary show a Chula Vista mayoral contest: Cheryl Cox 18,771 (53.55 percent), Steve Castaneda 9,886, Dominguez 4,561. The county November 2, 2010 results contain no Chula Vista mayoral contest. The office was probably decided in the primary, but no official source was found for the 2010 rule that a primary majority elects the mayor. The current charter (sections 300 and 901) and the clerk page describe a top-two runoff with no majority exception, and the legislative history in the charter shows section 300 was amended on 11-06-12, so the pre-2012 text differs. The pre-2012 charter text could not be retrieved (city site HTTP 403, municipal code site HTTP 403, no archived 2010 charter found). The year is marked unresolved and no result is recorded. Second pass: the web search budget was exhausted, and WebFetch could not open web.archive.org. Direct curl to the Internet Archive returned HTTP 429 (availability API) or no response, the municipal code site returned HTTP 403, the city clerk page returned HTTP 403, and the Municode library page returned no charter text. No official source for the pre-2012 primary-majority rule was obtained, so the year stays unresolved.

The Chula Vista city clerk elections page (direct fetch returned HTTP 403; read through the Internet Archive capture of 2026-04-08) states that the city consolidates its elections with statewide elections in each even-numbered year, that the Mayor is elected at large, that the top two candidates from the spring primary go to a November runoff, and that each term is four years. The page does not list individual mayoral election years. The county past-election index lists no San Diego County election of any kind in 2011. Chula Vista elections are consolidated with even-year statewide elections, and the city clerk page lists no off-year mayoral election. The Chula Vista Charter section 300(D) (archived municipal code page) sets a four-year mayoral term, but neither the charter nor the clerk page lists election years. Status no_election rests on the county index and files listed here.
